title: Cloud File Storage, S3 Streams & Presigned URLs
description: The ferrox-storage crate provides cloud object storage abstractions for Rust applications. It supports zero-buffer multipart streaming uploads, presigned download/upload URL generation, path traversal sanitization, and multi-provider backends (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, and local disk).
